m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (global-crew.md, global-everyone.md), the handoff, and the g1 files (frame/floor/holdout) + g2 (layer1_physics). Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: context + handoff + g1/g2 files loaded; handoff complete; data facts verified (grip_bin_obs Q is 2023-ONLY, 9 weekends)

m1-frame-fit.title: Grip-evolution frame + smooth within-session track latent with sigma
m1-frame-fit.imperative: Build layer2_evolution.py slice 1: load_grip_evolution_frame() (join grip_bin_obs Q with damage_lap_integrals.cumulative_track_laps, read-only, absolute main-checkout path) and fit_track_evolution() (per-weekend smooth field-level grip latent vs cumulative_track_laps, controlling tyre_life + bin FE, honest sigma, coverage=2023-only). TDD: write test asserting the fit yields a positive within-session rubbering signal and a 2023-only coverage set, observe RED, then GREEN.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: new test written and observed failing (manual attest)
frame+fit slice green: smooth latent fits, positive signal, 2023-only coverage

check.command: cd /c/Programs/f1-626 && py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/weekend_state/test_layer2_evolution.py -q -k 'frame or fit or coverage' 2>&1 | tail -5

payload.cmd: cd /c/Programs/f1-626 && py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/weekend_state/test_layer2_evolution.py -q -k 'frame or fit or coverage' 2>&1 | tail -5

m2-apply-fallback.title: apply path + wide-sigma near-zero fallback outside coverage
m2-apply-fallback.imperative: Slice 2: apply_track_evolution(ctl, year, gp, fit) returns (delta_grip, sigma) from the smooth latent inside 2023 coverage, and a WIDE-sigma near-zero prior (mean 0, wide sigma) outside coverage -- no fabricated values. TDD: test asserts fallback mean==0 and sigma is wide; observe RED then GREEN.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: fallback test written and observed failing (manual attest)
apply+fallback green: wide-sigma near-zero prior outside 2023

check.command: cd /c/Programs/f1-626 && py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/weekend_state/test_layer2_evolution.py -q -k 'apply or fallback' 2>&1 | tail -5

constraints: do NOT fabricate values outside 2023 coverage -- wide-sigma prior only

payload.cmd: cd /c/Programs/f1-626 && py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/weekend_state/test_layer2_evolution.py -q -k 'apply or fallback' 2>&1 | tail -5

m3-loo.title: LOO out-of-sample identifiability harness (not self-inclusive)
m3-loo.imperative: Slice 3: loo_earns_keep() = leave-one-WEEKEND-out train/test of the ctl slope, held-out grip RMSE with vs without L2. MANDATORY: train and test weekends disjoint (never self-inclusive). TDD: test asserts LOO train/test are disjoint AND reduction is computed; RED then GREEN.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: LOO-disjointness test written and observed failing (manual attest)
LOO green: out-of-sample harness, train/test disjoint, held-out numbers produced

m4-orthogonality-verdict.title: Orthogonality-vs-season check + honest earns-keep/float verdict
m4-orthogonality-verdict.imperative: Slice 4: orthogonality_vs_season() (corr of within-session latent vs season-time; must be ~0) and an EARNS_KEEP_VERDICT constant/docstring stating honestly: signal identifiable within grip data + orthogonal to season, but FLOAT on g1 car-signal split (2023-only coverage + no per-car session-time bridge). TDD: test asserts orthogonality ~0 and the coverage caveat/verdict is present; then run the FULL test file green.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: orthogonality+verdict test written and observed failing (manual attest)

constraints: honest null/float is a complete outcome; do NOT fake an in-sample win; do NOT fill L2 with a season-time latent
